xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex502-2023-05-342" status="finalized">de yang <rs type="person" ref="db:4182" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dge bshes stod lung pa</rs>'i zhal nas | nga la ston pa'i 'du shes skyed cig byas na | khyed kyis rgas su khyod la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed na dang khyod dga' ste || bskyed la bzhag gi sems pa srid de ma skyed na yang ma skyes <lb edRef="inst:4473" n="5a6"/> su la gnod lta ba yin gsung skad de de mad pa yin gsung || de bas na bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes gsha' ma gcig skyes na gnas skabs dang mthar <expan>thug gis</expan> yon tan gong ma kun 'byung ba'o || de la sgrub pa'i bsnyen bkur ni | nyon mongs pa <lb edRef="inst:4473" n="5a7"/> dang nyes spyod spongs pa dang | dge ba la brtson pa gnyis yin te || de ltar ma byas na bla ma'i bka' bcag pa yin gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
